TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A modern clinical treatment room featuring a large hyperbaric-style oxygen therapy bed on wheels, its body white with a blue stripe and fitted with a curved transparent acrylic canopy over a white mattress. A circular white ring housing glows with blue LED light at the head of the chamber, and a second identical transparent-canopied chamber bed stands near floor-to-ceiling windows with a city skyline of high-rise towers beyond. The room has glossy tiled floors, dark wall panels with a blue light strip, ceiling spotlights, potted plants, medical monitors on stands, and a stainless steel utility cart; black cables run along the floor beneath the front chamber.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dark digital artwork of a glowing Earth seen from space at night dominating the upper frame, showing the Americas, Europe and Africa traced in golden city lights against deep blue oceans. Below, a silhouetted city skyline with lit windows sits on the horizon above a dark reflective body of water, while the foreground is a vast circuit-board-like plain of golden and blue branching lines with glowing nodes that converge into a central trunk and spread toward the viewer like roots or highways; faint rain streaks fall through the night sky.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: water

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dark aerial digital composition split in two registers: the upper half shows a dim city at night seen from above, with rooftop blocks, intersecting streets dotted with orange streetlights, sparse lit windows, and one taller high-rise glowing at upper left. The lower half is a near-black open plain crossed by thin glowing circuit-board-style lines in blue and orange that radiate outward from a small bright central hub in a starburst pattern, echoing the street grid above as if the city's roads continued as circuit traces.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dark digital artwork in two registers joined by a single vertical beam of blue light. The upper register is a moody night city street between tall dark buildings with scattered lit windows and warm streetlights, the wet road reflecting light as the luminous blue beam descends from the sky and strikes the street's center. The lower register is a dark void where the beam terminates in a brilliant golden point, from which thin orange and blue circuit-board lines radiate outward in branching starburst patterns across the blackness like a circuit network or root system.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dark digital artwork in two stacked registers. The upper register is a rainy night city avenue flanked by tall apartment towers with warm lit windows, streetlamps casting orange pools, cars driving toward the viewer, and silhouetted pedestrians on the sidewalks; a brilliant cyan beam of light drops vertically from the sky to the middle of the wet street. The lower register is a subterranean darkness where a vertical blue line continues downward from the street into a radiant golden node, with thin blue and amber circuit-board traces branching outward in a vast radial network like an underground circuit or root system.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dark digital rendering of the Earth from space filling the frame against black, centered on the Atlantic Ocean with the Americas at left and Europe and Africa at upper right. The continents are dimly outlined while glowing electric-blue network filaments spread across the oceans and landmasses, and warm orange clusters of light mark populated coastlines such as eastern North America and southern South America. Every thread converges on a single brilliant golden-white node in the mid-Atlantic, giving the impression of a global connective network anchored at one central point.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: water

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A dark cyberpunk-style cityscape at night during rain, viewed down a wet avenue that reflects streetlamp light, with tall buildings showing scattered lit windows and antennas on rooftops. Hovering huge in the sky above the street is a giant glowing cyan holographic wireframe rendering of the characters "4B", drawn in a circuitry-like digital style with light streaks raining off it, dominating the scene like a billboard in the clouds.
TEXT: 4B
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A modern clinical treatment room, apparently identical or near-identical to another chamber photo in this set, featuring a large hyperbaric-style therapy bed with a white body, blue accent stripe, and clear acrylic canopy over a white mattress; its circular head ring glows with blue LED light. A second transparent-canopied chamber bed stands near floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a skyline of residential high-rises, with glossy tile floors, dark accent walls with a blue light strip, potted plants, medical monitors, a stainless steel cart, and black cables on the floor beneath the foreground chamber.
TEXT: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A wide dark digital composition in two registers. The upper register is a realistic night view down a city avenue, with lit storefronts, warm streetlamps, pedestrians on both sidewalks, cars with headlights approaching over a crosswalk, and a distant skyline of towers whose centerpiece is a tall art-deco spire resembling the Empire State Building. The lower register cross-sections into the ground, revealing a vast circuit-board landscape of thin blue and orange glowing traces with luminous nodes that branch outward from a central trunk aligned beneath the avenue, as if a digital network ran under the street.
